brandbook.motif: El borde de trabajo: una junta diagonal moderada entre superficie de acero y plano azul petróleo, con marcador de cobre que identifica la elección activa. Proviene del filo y del encuentro de materiales del taller; organiza selección, especificación y estado sin cruzar fotografías ni obstaculizar controles.

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Build recognition through the chair, the diagonal material joint and a precise selection edge. Describe a fictional workshop concept, never an established business history.

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Express design intent rather than inventing corporate commitments. Give discovery and booking equal clarity, with the same visual care on every interior route.

examples.text: Conoce el concepto. Explora los servicios. Elige un turno.
examples.title: Editorial direction

examples.text: Show service, date and time before contact fields. Keep the selected option recognizable through review and confirmation.
examples.title: Task direction

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Treat precision, restraint and care as design principles, not claimed business credentials. Make them visible in alignment, honest labels and readable controls.

examples.text: One shared edge aligns service name, demo price and selection marker.
examples.title: Precision

examples.text: Use one copper emphasis per task area. Preserve entered details when explaining an error.
examples.title: Restraint and care

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write interface copy in clear Spanish. Use short sentences and concrete verbs; avoid luxury clichés, invented testimonials, urgency and unsupported service promises.

examples.text: Elige tu servicio y consulta los turnos disponibles.
examples.title: Direct invitation

examples.text: Ese turno ya no está disponible. Tus datos siguen aquí; elige otro horario.
examples.title: Useful correction

examples.text: Do not write “La mejor barbería de Bogotá” or invent years of experience, staff biographies or satisfied-customer counts.
examples.title: Avoid

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Introduce the logo on Brushed Steel with generous empty space. Present the symbol and name as a single visual relationship, without turning the divider into a logo catalogue.

examples.text: Filo Azul · Una junta, dos planos, un filo.
examples.title: Section copy

examples.text: Use Petroleum Blue geometry and a Copper joint. Keep the name separate from the symbol artwork.
examples.title: Presentation rule

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The original symbol joins two petroleum planes around a copper incision of approximately 12°. It represents a working edge, not scissors, a barber pole or an initial inside a box.

examples.text: Place the symbol to the left of Filo Azul. Align the name optically with the center of the complete silhouette.
examples.title: Master relationship

examples.text: Use the symbol alone for a favicon or avatar; retain both planes and the copper joint.
examples.title: Small-space version

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Render Filo Azul in real Sora 600 typography, with natural letterforms and slightly tight spacing. Do not embed lettering into the symbol SVG or cut diagonals into the font.

examples.text: Filo Azul
examples.title: Primary lockup

examples.text: In a 48 px symbol canvas, set the name at 28 px and leave 12 px between canvas and name. Use a minimum 24 px symbol canvas in navigation.
examples.title: Size relationship

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Let x equal one quarter of the symbol’s visible width. Keep at least x clear around the complete lockup; measure from artwork and letters, not the SVG canvas.

examples.text: For a 40 px visible symbol, reserve at least 10 px outside the lockup before navigation, borders or other content.
examples.title: Header spacing

examples.text: Put the lockup on a quiet support surface rather than using empty space between the chair and tools as its safezone.
examples.title: Photographic placement

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Preserve the symbol’s Petroleum Blue and Copper fills. On dark, copper or photographic backgrounds, add a Cold White support surface large enough to include the safezone.

examples.text: Cold White #EFF4F5 supports the original symbol and a Petroleum Blue #153E55 name.
examples.title: Light application

examples.text: On #153E55 or #AF552F, use a #EFF4F5 support panel. Do not recolor individual symbol planes to compensate.
examples.title: Colored application

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Use the supplied geometric master unchanged. Its horizontal silhouette and open diagonal channels must remain visible; the copper joint is integral, not an optional underline.

examples.text: Use a 32 px canvas for compact navigation and 48 px for profile studies. Reserve the 16 px version for browser icons.
examples.title: Application sizes

examples.text: Center the complete three-part silhouette, not just the upper petroleum plane.
examples.title: Optical balance

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Never stretch, rotate, outline, bevel or texture the mark. Avoid generic black-and-gold substitutions and keep photographic detail out of its open channels.

examples.text: Do not turn the copper joint into a metallic gold gradient or add scissors behind Filo Azul.
examples.title: Incorrect treatment

examples.text: Do not place the symbol across the chair, crop its lower plane or squeeze the name to fit a narrow header.
examples.title: Incorrect composition

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Introduce type with a large Spanish headline and a smaller practical sentence. Use Sora for character and IBM Plex Sans for reading, never a third decorative family.

examples.text: Explora los servicios y encuentra tu turno.
examples.title: Un corte con carácter.

examples.text: Set the headline in Sora 700 and the supporting line in IBM Plex Sans 400, aligned to one working edge.
examples.title: Divider composition

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Pair Sora 600–700 headings with IBM Plex Sans 400–600 body and controls. Supplied distributable files cover these weights; local font delivery belongs to the planned application.

examples.text: Cada cita ocupa una silla durante 60 minutos.
examples.title: Elige tu turno

examples.text: Keep service names in Sora and explanations, prices, dates and fields in IBM Plex Sans.
examples.title: Family roles

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: Use Sora for short, distinctive headings. Set display text at 40–88 px by viewport, with approximately 1.05 line height; avoid long paragraphs and forced all-caps.

examples.text: Una propuesta de taller para descubrir el ritual del corte.
examples.title: La silla, el filo y el turno.

examples.text: At 390 px, start at 40 px. Break the cover headline deliberately and never compress letters to preserve a desktop line.
examples.title: Headline fit

pages.title: Typography: weights & style
pages.summary: Use Sora 700 for display and 600 for section headings. IBM Plex Sans uses 400 for body, 500 for labels and 600 for actions. Avoid synthetic bold, italics and condensed styling.

examples.text: Comprueba el servicio, la fecha, el turno y tus datos antes de guardar.
examples.title: Revisa tu reserva

examples.text: Turno · Contacto · Revisión: IBM Plex Sans 500, exactly 14 px with 20 px line height.
examples.title: Exact step style

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use IBM Plex Sans at 16–18 px for body and at least 16 px inside fields. Navigation and buttons start at 14 px; credits start at 12 px. Preserve Spanish accents and COP formatting.

examples.text: 45.000 COP · Precio demo · Turno de 60 minutos
examples.title: Corte clásico

examples.text: Use tabular numerals for 10:00–19:00 and aligned prices. Keep COP attached to its amount without breaking the line.
examples.title: Numeric rhythm

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Use one page heading, clear section headings and quiet helper text. A task label must outrank decoration; status and error messages must remain readable without relying on color.

examples.text: Selecciona una fecha para consultar disponibilidad.
examples.title: Elige tu turno

examples.text: Desktop cover 88/92; mobile cover 40/44; section 28/34; body 16/24; steps 14/20; credits 12/18, in px.
examples.title: Suggested scale

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use a 12-column desktop, 6-column tablet and 4-column mobile grid. Space on the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64 px scale. Keep booking content in normal document flow.

examples.text: Primero elige una opción y una fecha. Después completa tus datos.
examples.title: Tu servicio. Tu turno.

examples.text: Use 64 px desktop, 32 px tablet and 16 px mobile outer margins. At 390×600, show service, date and next available turn on arrival.
examples.title: Responsive working edge

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Use Petroleum Blue as the identity anchor, Cold White as breathing room and Copper as a deliberate signal. Express brushed steel through secondary surfaces, not simulated chrome.

examples.text: Azul petróleo. Acero. Un filo de cobre.
examples.title: Section copy

examples.text: Use a Copper field with a Cold White title or support panel. Avoid gradients, gold accents and near-black substitutions.
examples.title: Divider treatment

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Keep all five supplied hex values unchanged. Assign colors by semantic role, not by service; the same selection and text rules apply throughout the booking journey.

examples.text: Cold White #EFF4F5: background. Brushed Steel #D6E0E3: surface. Petroleum Blue #153E55: identity and primary text.
examples.title: Base and reading

examples.text: Working Copper #AF552F: action. Workshop Slate #536770: secondary text. Use Cold White text on Copper buttons, not Petroleum Blue.
examples.title: Action and support

examples.text: Use Petroleum Blue or Workshop Slate text on Cold White and Steel. Avoid small Copper text on Steel; reserve that pairing for non-text markers.
examples.title: Contrast pairing

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Keep text and controls in solid palette colors. Tints may soften large decorative surfaces only; they must not create new semantic tokens or weaken selected and focus states.

examples.text: Use solid Brushed Steel beneath a service family. A subtle Petroleum Blue texture at 4% opacity may sit outside photographs.
examples.title: Quiet workshop surface

examples.text: Keep selected Copper at full opacity. Pair unavailable slots with explicit text and disabled semantics, not a pale tint alone.
examples.title: State discipline

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: Use a diagonal joint of approximately 12° at one frame edge or selection marker. Keep content rectangles intact, with 8 px control corners and no diagonal clipping of tools or seats.

examples.text: A 4 px copper rail marks Corte y barba; its short diagonal end echoes the symbol without becoming a second logo.
examples.title: Selection edge

examples.text: Cut only a modest outer corner of the photographic frame. The image itself stays rectangular and recognizable.
examples.title: Frame treatment

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Draw functional icons on a 24 px grid with consistent 1.75 px strokes. Use Petroleum Blue by default, pair unfamiliar symbols with labels and reserve the brandmark for identity.

examples.text: Fecha — pair the calendar icon with its visible label and a touch target of at least 44×44 px.
examples.title: Calendar control

examples.text: Use a clockwise arrow for Recargar and a simple chevron for Abrir detalle. Never make a scissors icon stand for cancellation.
examples.title: Navigation actions

pages.title: Photography
pages.summary: Use the supplied documentary source with natural color and crisp detail. Preserve the original separately from crops. Do not imply that the photographed shop is Filo Azul.

examples.text: Fotografía representativa, no del local ficticio. Visitor7 · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Imagen recortada.
examples.title: Visible photo credit

examples.text: Keep the chair complete enough to read as the focal object. Place the CTA on its lower frame edge, never across the seat.
examples.title: Framing rule

examples.text: Use a distinct crop only if recognizable tools retain enough detail. Otherwise use a separately licensed source, not an invented view.
examples.title: Tools scene

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Combine documentary chair photography, quiet steel surfaces, geometric type and one copper incision. The chosen direction is editorial workshop, not luxury lounge or software dashboard.

examples.text: La silla, el filo y el turno: broad headline above a dominant photograph, followed by a grounded action band.
examples.title: Chosen composition

examples.text: Keep authentic materials and open margins. Exclude black-and-gold styling, neon barber poles, stock haircut results and glossy metal effects.
examples.title: Keep / exclude

pages.summary: Design study: use Copper primary buttons, 44 px minimum targets and visible labels. Selection moves the marker in 180 ms without moving focus; reduced motion makes the change immediate.

brandbook.voice: Español claro, cercano y preciso. Frases breves con vocabulario de corte, contorno, silla y turno; sin grandilocuencia, testimonios ni credenciales inventadas. Un aviso discreto por página identifica la demostración; la confirmación explica que el registro no constituye una cita real.
